pib.title: Indian Railways Approves New Tri-Weekly Train Between Machilipatnam and Kurnool City via Vijayawada of South Coast Railway
pib.summary: Release text as printed (first sentence): 'In a major relief to the commuters of Andhra Pradesh, the Indian Railways has approved a new tri-weekly train service between Machilipatnam and Kurnool City via Vijayawada of South Coast Railway, providing an additional rail connectivity option between coastal and central parts of Andhra Pradesh'

pib.title: Union Health Minister Shri J P Nadda Inaugurates Critical Care Blocks and Integrated Public Health Laboratories in Andhra Pradesh
pib.summary: Release text as printed (first sentence): 'Union Minister for Health & Family Welfare, Shri Jagat Prakash Nadda today inaugurated 10 Critical Care Blocks (CCBs) and 12 Integrated Public Health Laboratories (IPHLs) in Andhra Pradesh in the presence of Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh Shri N. Chandrababu Naidu and Minister for Health, Family Welfare & Medical Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh Shri Satya Kumar Yadav, along with Members of Parliament, Members of the Legislative Assembly and Legislative Council, senior officers, doctors'

pib.title: PM to visit Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka on 1 August
pib.summary: Release text as printed (first sentence): 'Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi will visit Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka on 1 August 2026.
